Christopher Marlowe, The Tragical History of Doctor Faustus.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/christopher-marlowe/the-tragical-history-of-doctor-faustus

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Christopher Marlowe, the author, died 1593 (UK).

First publication of the text used: 1604 (SE colophon: 'published in 1604' (A-text quarto)).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1604, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1699.
- Country of origin (UK): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1593, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 1664.
